brief: 6 productivity tips from a designer who built a 7-figure studio.

slots.headline: 6 productivity habits that built a 7-figure design studio

slots.title: Time-block deep work
slots.body: Protect three hours daily for focused design without meetings or notifications. This single habit will 10x your creative output faster than any new app.

slots.title: Build template libraries
slots.body: Stop designing from scratch by saving every repeated asset as a reusable component. Your future self will thank you when deadlines hit hard.

slots.title: Batch client feedback
slots.body: Check emails only twice daily to avoid context switching that fragments your creative flow. Guard your attention like your most valuable billable hour.

slots.title: Automate admin tasks
slots.body: Use simple workflows to handle invoicing, scheduling, and file organization without lifting a finger. Free up brain space for the work that actually pays.

slots.title: Reject scope creep
slots.body: Define project boundaries in writing before you open any design software. Protecting your time is how you scale without burning out.

slots.title: Review weekly goals
slots.body: Zoom out every Friday to measure progress against quarterly goals instead of sweating inbox zero. Strategy beats busywork every single time.
